fields.summary: Residents at a meeting with Google's team about the Waltham Cross data centre raised noise (a hum in the evening), night-time lighting in bedrooms, and poor consultation; a council representative said only 12 people attended the previous public meeting.
fields.source_title: The Register — Google meets the neighbors and gets both barrels over its new UK datacenter

records.notes: Single secondary source (The Register). Meeting date is only 'Wednesday evening'; the article date 24 Jul 2026 is used. Google's own statement on heat re-routing is NOT in this article and is not used.
